item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 William Chow, Jonathan Baugh
arXiv:2611.13371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes can reduce the number of data qubits required per logical qubit, but their checks require long-range interactions on a planar device. We develop a singlet fabric for bivariate-bicycle codes on a silicon node network. Spin singlets are generated on shuttling lanes and distributed between nodes, where local operations consume them to measure non-local stabilizers. We construct two syndrome-extraction circuits, based on distributed GHZ states and ancilla teleportation, and evaluate them using hardware-constrained schedules and circuit-level memory simulations. item.title: Normalizing Flows for Classical Simulation of Quantum Circuits in Phase Space
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Edward Jiang, Timothy Heightman, Marcin Płodzień
arXiv:2611.14006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a novel framework to learn a representation of quantum circuits based on the phase space formulation of many-body systems. Given that N-qubit states can be represented as probability distributions on a smooth 2N-dimensional manifold, we show how unitary gates can be parameterized as normalizing flows between these distributions, opening a new avenue for quantum circuit simulation using generative models. We evaluate our method on three common families of quantum circuits, and show that its accuracy exceeds that of current state-of-the-art neural network methods for large system sizes.

arXiv:2611.13373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although belief propagation (BP) is a widely adopted decoder for classical low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, its accuracy is limited in the quantum setting. PriorTilt{} achieves a lower logical error rate (LER) than both baselines at every tested data point. item.title: 非对称量子纠错有效应对应用特定噪声效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abhishek Yadav, Peter K. Schuhmacher, Michael Epping
本文探讨了量子计算机中比特翻转和相位翻转噪声对算法性能的不对称影响。以量子近似优化算法（QAOA）应用于飞行门分配问题为例，研究发现比特翻转噪声对QAOA性能的退化更大。这种不对称性在层级和原生RZZ模拟中最为显著，并通过错误的交换和传播特性及其对最终计算基测量的影响进行解释。

item.title: 物质拓扑相中贝里相估计的计算复杂性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ryu Hayakawa, Kazuki Sakamoto, Chusei Kiumi
本文提出了一种新的量子算法，并给出了贝里相估计（BPE）问题的复杂性理论结果。新算法在更通用的设置下实现了BPE，并提供了理论保证。研究证明，当给定与基态有大重叠的引导态时，BPE问题是BQP完全的，这确立了指数级的量子加速。此外，当已知基态能量的先验界限时，BPE问题是UQMA ∩ co-UQMA完全的，这是已知第一个属于该复杂性类的自然问题。

item.title: 量子纠错低噪声极限下最大概率解码与最大似然解码的差异
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yixin Zhao, Fei Yan
本文研究了量子纠错在渐近低噪声极限下，最大概率（MP）解码和最大似然（MLD）解码两种最优规则之间的差异。研究确定了在何种物理错误权重下，MP和MLD的逻辑胜出集会变得可证明地不相交。结果揭示了一个三级层次结构，表明MLD在低噪声下由于最小权重错误的重数而保留了残余的零温度简并性，这可能超过单个最可能错误的影响。

item.title: QAdapt：用于表面码量子纠错的噪声自适应神经预解码
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ran Miao, Rui Luo, Xiaohan Shan, Xiaoming Sun
容错量子计算依赖量子纠错，但硬件噪声和模拟与实验之间的分布差异挑战了固定神经解码器的准确性。本文提出了QAdapt，一个用于表面码量子纠错的噪声自适应神经预解码框架。QAdapt学习局部时空关联，持续适应不同噪声环境，并将残余综合征传递给传统全局解码器。实验结果表明，QAdapt显著降低了逻辑错误率，并有效减少了遗忘。

item.title: 量子纠错与生物纠错：量子比特与神经元之间的结构类比
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ian Whitehouse, Anil Zenginoğlu, Franz Klein, Mohe Edeen Abu Maizer, Wilson Smith, Skylar Chan, Siri Duddella, Wolfgang Losert
本文在冗余编码和基于约束的推理方面，将量子纠错（QEC）与神经回路中的错误处理进行了结构类比。QEC将逻辑信息嵌入受保护的码空间中，通过评估检查来识别错误。神经回路也通过将信息分布在多个神经元上实现可靠的集体活动，这引发了集体活动是否也受限于低维流形（生物码空间）的问题，从而允许循环电路动力学和不匹配信号发挥作用。
